primary.numerator: commitment instances with >=1 authoritative receipt of the goal type, actor and place, within their own revision
primary.denominator: all commitment instances created in the game (initial + checkpoint/follow-up delegations)
primary.nullPolicy: if a game has 0 instances -> null (not 0)

exposure.notExposed: null / not_exposed when the pre-registered story precondition never coexisted with an active instance (legal early completion included)

rates.note: food: 8 NPCs x 0.9 hunger/h, 1 food == 1 hunger in survival-rules/2; firewood: furnace burn 0.4/h in evolveSpan; power: heating reserve denominator (2/h) used by the R10 coverage report, not a physical drain.

gap.definition: hours in [start,end) where the authoritative level is <= 0, integrating the sampled timeline with the left-hand value

tolerance: no statistical claim from 2 seeds; report per-seed pairs and their difference
